title: Hearing music at home and the Mares family band
summary: As a child he heard family music; Paul Mares's father practised nearby with his father.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh yes! Before I played, well I was a kid and my kid brother, my brother, at least my brother Jules, he played music around the house and my sister, my bop and all. They played, you know, this Paul stuff, the family thing. And incidentally, Paul Mares, a trumpet player at the New Orleans Rhythm King, his father, they lived just a couple of blocks from my house, see, and they used to have a little band, they used to practice, you know, and play, I don't know how to explain this thing, but my dad played alto with the band and then, Paul's father played trumpet, and they had other guys playing trombone and so forth, and this and that. And he used to take me to these get-togethers, they used to get together, and they'd be practicing and probably have some beer or something like that, you know. But, uh, I used to listen, and that was too legitimate for me, see, because I could see in my head and in my mind that all they're playing is something that somebody else wrote.
Nothing creative about it. Nothing, ah, nah, nah, now we get somewhere, see.
